case_name: Smti Junaki Shyam Boro vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smti Junaki Shyam Boro, wife of Late Biseswar Boro
parties.respondent_defendant: The State Of Assam And 6 Ors (including the Commissioner and Secretary to the Govt. of Assam, Public Health Engineering Department, etc.)

facts_of_case: Petitioner's husband Late Biseswar Boro retired from service on 28.02.2009 and drew his pension amount in State Bank of India, Bokajan Branch. He died on 23.04.2012, leaving behind the petitioner and their three sons. Petitioner approached respondent authorities claiming family pension of her deceased husband.

legal_principles.principle: The authenticity of a claim for family pension does not arise if the requisite documents are submitted by the employee during his lifetime.
legal_principles.held: Accordingly the question of verification of authenticity of the claim for family pension by the answering respondent No.4 does not arise.

legal_principles.principle: The name of the family pensioner recorded in the pension papers is conclusive evidence.
legal_principles.held: While authorizing the PPO, the name of family pensioner was recorded as Smti. Kabe Ingtipi (respondent No.7) as the wife of the employee, on the basis of the records/pension forms, furnished by the pension forwarding authority...
